name: Women Scientist Scheme-A
teBrief: సైన్స్ మరియు ఇంజనీరింగ్ యొక్క సరిహద్దు రంగాలలో పరిశోధనను కొనసాగించడానికి మహిళా అభ్యర్థులకు, ప్రాధాన్యంగా కెరీర్లో విరామం (కనీసం రెండు సంవత్సరాలు) మరియు క్రమం తప్పకుండా ఉద్యోగం లేని వారికి, వృత్తిలోకి తిరిగి ప్రవేశించే అవకాశాన్ని…
brief: A Research Grant by MoST for female candidates to pursue research in frontier areas of science and engineering, preferably those having a break in career (minimum two years) and not having regular employment, to explore possibility of re-entry into the profession.

details:
A Research Grant by MoST for female candidates to pursue research in frontier areas of science and engineering, preferably those having a break in career (minimum two years) and not having regular employment, to explore possibility of re-entry into the profession.

This scheme will provide a research grant for a well-defined project proposal for a period of maximum three years. This grant will cover the fellowship of the applicant and cost of small equipments, contingencies, travel, consumables, etc. Institutional overhead charges will be extra.

The support is available in 5 disciplines under WOS-A namely, i) Physical & Mathematical Sciences (PMS), ii) Chemical Sciences (CS), iii) Life Sciences (LS), iv) Earth & Atmospheric Sciences (EAS), and v) Engineering Technology (ET).

The scheme plays pivotal role in gender mainstreaming as it not only prevents brain drain from S&T system but also train and retain women in the system. The scheme initially offers opportunity to work as bench-level scientists and ultimately open new avenues for permanent position in Science & Technology.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a FEMALE.
1. The applicant must **either be unemployed or in a position other than regular/permanent position.**1. The age of the applicant must be between 27 and 57 years **(5 year relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and physically challenged candidates)**1. The applicant must hold either of the following **Minimum essential qualification** - 

- Minimum Post Graduate degree, equivalent to M.Sc. in Basic or Applied Sciences or B.Tech. or MBBS or other equivalent professional qualifications.
- M.Phil/M.Tech/M.Pharm/M.VSc or equivalent qualifications.
- Ph.D. in Basic or Applied Sciences.
documentsRequired:
- Project Proposal Document (Refer source for Format)
- Biodata of PI (Signed) (Refer source for Format)
- Mentor’s Biodata (Signed)
- Caste Certificate (If SC/ST/OBC/PH)
- DOB certificate (10th class passed only)
- Photograph of PI
- Signature of PI
- Highest Degree
- House Rent Allowance (if Eligible) (Refer source for Format)

Sources:
https://online-wosa.gov.in/wosa/instructions

faqs.q: Is there a validity to the scheme benefits?
faqs.a: The benefits are provided for a period of maximum three years.

faqs.q: Are contingencies covered under the research grant?
faqs.a: This grant will cover the fellowship of the applicant and cost of small equipments, contingencies, travel, consumables, etc.
faqs.qTe: ఆకస్మిక పరిస్థితులు రీసెర్చ్ గ్రాంట్ పరిధిలోకి వస్తాయా?

faqs.q: What would be the mode of payment of the scholarship?
faqs.a: The payment of the scholarship will be through DBT.

faqs.q: Are temporary/contractual assignments considered as break?
faqs.a: Yes, all temporary/contractual assignments in academics and research are  considered as break.

faqs.q: Will I be eligible for the scholarship if I fail to get promoted to the next semester?
faqs.a: No. The scholarship will be terminated in that case.
faqs.qTe: నేను తదుపరి సెమిస్టర్కు పదోన్నతి పొందడంలో విఫలమైతే స్కాలర్షిప్కు అర్హత పొందుతానా?

faqs.q: Can I apply offline for the scholarship?
faqs.a: No. You need to visit  https://online-wosa.gov.in/wosa/ to apply.
faqs.qTe: నేను స్కాలర్షిప్ కోసం ఆఫ్లైన్లో దరఖాస్తు చేయవచ్చా?

faqs.a: No. The entire application process is completely free of cost.

faqs.q: Which scientific disciplines are covered under this grant?
faqs.a:
i) Physical & Mathematical Sciences (PMS), 
ii) Chemical Sciences (CS), 
iii) Life Sciences (LS), 
iv) Earth & Atmospheric Sciences (EAS), and
 v) Engineering Technology (ET)
faqs.qTe: ఈ గ్రాంట్ కింద ఏ శాస్త్రీయ విభాగాలు ఉన్నాయి?

faqs.q: Is it possible to pursue PhD along with a  WOS-A project?
faqs.a: Yes, the beneficiary is allowed to do so.
faqs.qTe: డబ్ల్యూఓఎస్-ఏ ప్రాజెక్టుతో పాటు పీహెచ్డీ చేయడం సాధ్యమేనా?

faqs.q: I am 24 years in age. Can I apply for the scheme?
faqs.a: Women scientists, less than 27 years of age are not eligible.
faqs.qTe: నా వయసు 24 సంవత్సరాలు. నేను ఈ పథకానికి దరఖాస్తు చేయవచ్చా?

faqs.q: Do I need to complete the application in one sitting?
faqs.a: No. You can save the application as draft and continue at a later time before the deadline.
faqs.qTe: నేను ఒకే సిట్టింగ్లో దరఖాస్తును పూర్తి చేయాల్సిన అవసరం ఉందా?

faqs.q: What should be the type and size of the documents to be uploaded?
faqs.a: The format should be.pdf. The size of each document should not be greater than 2MB.
faqs.qTe: అప్లోడ్ చేయవలసిన పత్రాల రకం మరియు పరిమాణం ఎంత ఉండాలి?

faqs.q: How do I know if a field in the application form is mandatory?
faqs.a: The mandatory fields have a red asterisk (*) mark at the end.
faqs.qTe: దరఖాస్తు ఫారంలో ఒక ఫీల్డ్ తప్పనిసరి అని నాకు ఎలా తెలుస్తుంది?

faqs.q: I have a query regarding the application process. Whom should I contact regarding the same?
faqs.a: Please contact Dr. Vandana Singh for any query about WOS-A at vandana.singh@nic.in You may also call at 011-26590675 or 011-26590273 during 11am - 1pm in weekdays.
faqs.qTe: దరఖాస్తు ప్రక్రియకు సంబంధించి నాకు ఒక ప్రశ్న ఉంది. దీనికి సంబంధించి నేను ఎవరిని సంప్రదించాలి?
